mechanism.mechanism_of_action: Bispecific monoclonal antibody targeting both PD-1 and TIGIT receptors, designed to enhance antitumor activity beyond anti-PD-(L)1 therapy by activating T-cell immune response

clinical.indications: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), PD-L1-positive metastatic NSCLC

market.market_position: First PD-1/TIGIT bispecific in development, promising early efficacy [uncertain]
